d: Manish Mundra is a film producer and founder of Drishyam Films, a production house which has produced some of the most amazing and offbeat films like Aankhon Dekhi, Masaan, Kadvi Hawa and Newton which have defined a new era in Indian Cinema. He is also a philanthropist who is known for his immense contribution during the COVID pandemic in helping the migrant workers reach their home towns, and providing hospitals with ventilators, PPE kits and oxygen concentrators.
